name: Read member savings balance (green screen)
description: Look up a member on the MERIDIAN green-screen terminal and return the current balance of their share savings account.
goal: Sign on at the terminal, look up member {{memberId}}, and reach the member detail screen showing their share savings balance.

inputs.name: memberId
inputs.description: The member number to look up.

probes.description: No member record exists for the number supplied.
The operator is not authorised to view this member record.
